bundle.shortDescription: Offline 2D AI motion & vector animation studio
bundle.longDescription: Kinetix Studio is a 100% offline native 2D animation suite: Bézier drawing, parent-child rigging, realistic 2D lighting, vector morphing, kinetic typography and a local-LLM AI Director — with a deterministic 60 FPS exporter to MP4, GIF, PNG sequence, SVG and JSON.
